title: A non-technician lead keeps the dropdown even where no one is a technician
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new location for this test, location C, in the same organization, where no enrolled staff member is a technician (every staff member enrolled there has Technician off), so the board there has no technician.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at location C only.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at location C, in Approved, led by staff member A, with staff member A's Technician then switched off (and the warning saved).
  • Switch to location C.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Lead Technician dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 shows staff member A as its lead.

Step 2:

  • The dropdown shows and lists "Unassigned" and staff member A.
  • Staff member A is grayed out.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R7a: “If a location has no technicians and the work order has no lead, the Lead Technician field shows as read-only text, the label "Lead technician" with "Unassigned" under it, as it does today whenever that list is empty. If the work order's lead is not a technician, the dropdown still shows (S3-R7), listing "Unassigned" and that lead, grayed out, even when the location has no technicians.”
  • S3-R7: “A work order's current lead who is not offered per S3-R1 still shows as the lead on the work order and in Board View and Tech View. In the Lead Technician dropdown they are listed last, grayed out, with the check mark, and cannot be picked. Picking someone else saves at once, as today, and the former lead then leaves the dropdown.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "5 Board View and Tech View", picture "Board View" (This build); page "6 Technician dropdowns on a work order", picture "Lead Technician" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p5-02-after-board-view.png
  • tt-p6-02-after-lead-technician.png

The design's own words:

  • “No column for her: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. A column only appears for staff whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on.”
  • “Someone whose Technician is turned off but who still leads open work keeps a column for that work, so nothing they lead disappears from the board.”
  • “Not offered: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. The list holds only staff whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on.”
  • “A current lead who is not a technician any more stays the lead, listed last, grayed out with the check, so the current lead never reads as blank (PRD S3-R7).”

A former technician lead is described, not drawn: the after pictures have no lead (register TT-N07).
